Whether you're organizing your kitchen, setting up a coffee bar, or just love a clutter-free countertop, these are a must-have. Functional, minimal, and straight-up beautiful.

Maybe the kids can use them to build sandcastles at the beach because I don't really have a use for them.These are described as glass, but they are clearly not glass. They are hard plastic. I was looking to replace most of my plastic storage because I heard a report that plastic contains Phthalates, which cause cancer. They will not help, so they are being returned.I ordered two jars, one of them came perfect, the other one came with a lid that does not fit and therefore does not create a seal and is unusable. The lid is too small and does not cover any of the 4 corners of the jar.I bought smaller (50 oz) containers from this brand and was very pleased. I ordered the larger containers expecting the same quality which, unfortunately, I didn't get. On both 150 oz containers, the silicone seal does not touch the glass in places. On one of the two containers, an air gap is clearly visible in the corner. I was planning on using these containers to hold bird seed but the seed would be unprotected from a bug infestation. Very disappointed and will have to find a different glass container.3 OF THE 6 ARRIVED BROKENThis is my second time ordering these jars and it’s the second time half of them have arrived absolutely shattered.Four of them work great and are super cute, but two whole jars have one corner that isn’t correctly shaped, and leaves a big gap in the seal. So I essentially have four usable jars and two that aren’t. Frustrating for sure.The bottles when they arrived looked a little fragile. But since I was not storing anything heavy in them I decided it was ok. I have used it to store himalayan salt for last 6 months. One fine day I saw that the bottle's lid was not easy to remove, probably because the silicone seal was not seating properly. Next day the bottle just fell apart on its own. So my initial fears about this products fragility was confirmed. For the price paid these are not worth it if they last only 6-7 months.
